ValidationRule.description: If there is any product with special information the 'Product Information Reviewed' checkbox must be TRUE.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Special_Information_Line_Items__c >0, Product_Information_Reviewed__c = FALSE, ISCHANGED(SFDC_Integration_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(SFDC_Integration_Status__c, 'In Progress'), (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(SFDC_Integration_Status__c), "")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please review the products special information and then check the Product Information Reviewed box if you want to move forward in the process.
